about_the_game:
The American Automotive Car Pack is here to show the Horizon Festival some power! 4 American All-stars are here to unleash their muscle including: the 2020 Chevrolet Silverado LT Trail Boss, 2023 Czinger 21C, 2017 Saleen S7 LM, and the 1961 DeBerti Ford Econoline 'Shop Rod'.

Requires Forza Horizon 5 (game sold separately). Not included with the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass, Standard, Deluxe or Premium Editions.
